name: "Brace Yourself!"
concise_description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Prevents the next knock-down and deals {{Damage}} damage to all foes near target ally. Cannot self-target.

name: "Brace Yourself!" (PvP)
concise_description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Prevents the next knock-down and deals {{Damage}} damage to one foe near target ally. Cannot self-target.

name: "Can't Touch This!"
concise_description: Shout. (20 seconds.) The next {{Failures}} touch-range skill[s] used against allies [sic] within earshot fail[s].

name: "Can't Touch This!" (PvP)
concise_description: Shout. (20 seconds.) The next {{Failures}} touch-range skill[s] used against you fail[s].

name: "Fall Back!"
concise_description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Allies in earshot gain {{HealthGain}} Health per second while moving and move 33% faster. Ends for an ally if that ally hits with an attack.

name: "Fall Back!" (PvP)
concise_description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Allies in earshot gain {{HealthGain}} Health per second while moving and move 33% faster. Ends for an ally if that ally hits with an attack.

name: "Find Their Weakness!"
concise_description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target ally deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage and inflicts Deep Wound condition ({{DeepWound}} seconds) with the next attack.

name: "Find Their Weakness!" (PvP)
concise_description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target ally inflicts Deep Wound condition ({{DeepWoundDuration}} seconds) with the next critical hit.

name: "Go for the Eyes!"
concise_description: Shout. (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot have +{{PlusChancePercent}}% to land a critical hit with their next attack.

name: "Go for the Eyes!" (PvP)
concise_description: Shout. (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot have +{{PlusChancePercent}}% to land a critical hit with their next attack.

name: "Help Me!"
concise_description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Other allies' spells targeting you cast 50% faster. You gain {{HealthGain}} Health.

name: "Help Me!" (PvP)
concise_description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Other allies' spells targeting you cast 50% faster. You gain {{HealthGain}} Health.

name: "Incoming!"

concise_description: Elite Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds) Allies in earshot move 33% faster and gain {{HealthGain}} Health while moving.

name: "It's Just a Flesh Wound."
concise_description: Elite Shout. Remove all conditions from target ally. That ally moves 25% faster ({{Duration}} second[s]) if a condition was removed. Cannot self-target.

name: "Lead the Way!"
concise_description: Shout. Target ally moves 25% faster for {{Duration}} seconds (maximum of 20 seconds) for each ally in earshot.

name: "Make Haste!"
concise_description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target ally moves 33% faster. Ends if target ally hits with an attack. Cannot self-target.

name: "Make Your Time!"
concise_description: Shout. You gain one adrenaline (maximum {{Adrenaline}}) for each party member in earshot.

name: "Never Give Up!"
concise_description: Shout. Allies in earshot gain {{EnergyGain}} Energy. Only affects allies below 75% Health.

name: "Never Give Up!" (PvP)
concise_description: Shout. Allies in earshot gain {{EnergyGain}} Energy. Only affects allies below 75% Health.

name: "Never Surrender!"

name: "Never Surrender!" (PvP)

name: "Stand Your Ground!"
concise_description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Party members in earshot gain +24 armor when not moving.

name: "Stand Your Ground!" (PvP)
concise_description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Party members in earshot gain +24 armor when not moving. Ends for an ally if that ally attacks.

name: "The Power Is Yours!"
concise_description: Elite Shout. (3 seconds.) Allies within earshot gain {{EnergyRegeneration}} Energy regeneration.

name: "There's Nothing to Fear!"
concise_description: Shout. (4 seconds plus 1 second for every 2 ranks in Leadership.) Reduces damage by {{PercentDamageReduction}}% for party members in earshot. End effect: heals for {{Healing}} Health.

name: "They're on Fire!"
concise_description: Shout. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot take {{DamageReductionPercent}}% less damage from Burning foes.

name: "We Shall Return!"

concise_description: Shout. (10 seconds.) Whenever party members in earshot use a resurrection skill, their fallen allies return with {{MoreHealthPercent}}% more Health and {{MoreEnergyPercent}}% more Energy.
